name: Zendesk
oneLiner: Customer service platform (the Zendesk Resolution Platform) combining ticketing, messaging, voice, a help center and AI agents.
bestFor: Mid-size to large businesses, including multi-location restaurant and hospitality brands, that handle high contact volume across many channels.

updates.text: Announced (March 11) and completed (March 26) the acquisition of Forethought, an AI agent company; Forethought AI Agents by Zendesk cover chat, email and voice and add self-improving agents to the Resolution Platform.

features: Single agent workspace for email, messaging, live chat, social and voice
AI agents that answer common questions across chat, email and voice
Copilot add-on that suggests replies and next steps for human agents
Omnichannel routing and automated ticket triggers
Help center and knowledge base for self-service

pricing.text: Support Team from $19 per agent per month billed annually ($25 monthly); Suite Team $55 per agent per month billed annually ($69 monthly); Suite Professional $115 billed annually; Copilot is an add-on.

notes: zendesk.com could not be fetched from this session; prices come from search snippets of zendesk.com/pricing and agree with several 2026 third-party guides. Zendesk's own claim that its AI agents resolve over 80% of interactions was left out as a vendor claim. Original's 'hundreds of integrations' and 'millions of tickets' dropped.
